**Likely enzyme:** UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate–meso-2,6-diaminopimelate ligase (EC 6.3.2.13), a peptidoglycan-biosynthesis enzyme.

**Reaction:**

UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate + meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ATP  
→ UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-γ-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ADP + phosphate + H⁺

It adds meso-diaminopimelate to the UDP-linked peptidoglycan precursor, using ATP; the curated homolog annotations also indicate Mg²⁺ as a cofactor.

**Evidence:** The 510-aa sequence matches reviewed reference ligases at 43–46% identity across about 93–97% of the sequence. This strongly supports the assignment by homology, but the query protein’s activity has not been directly experimentally verified here.
